svg.aria-label: White et al. (2021), Figure 2, CC BY 4.0, reproduced in full with an external title. Red denotes CD4-positive and blue CD8-positive T cells, comparing one parameter per row. The horizontal axis is transformed; peak heights do not directly give population counts. Data originate from the paper’s EQAPOL study.
